title: Cover Flow
description: Music library with the classic 3D cover flow, mirrored reflections and momentum flicks.
steps: `itemSize` is 90 per 200 pt of cover, and `itemAnimation` puts ±1 at 120 from the center and every album beyond only 48 further, so the sides stack up.
Inside each item, `relativeProgress` turns the cover up to 62° on Y and scales it to 0.88, with a flipped copy underneath as the reflection.
`snapMode="nearest"` with `snapMomentum` 0.4 lets a flick skip several albums; `progress` swaps the caption, and the arrows call `ref.prev()` and `ref.next()`.
